evals.query: Set up Imagen MCP with my Azure OpenAI deployment and generate a 16:9 PNG.
Use the Imagen MCP to create three concept images and poll until they finish.
Edit this PNG with Imagen, then continue the edit session to make it warmer.
Why does my Imagen MCP Azure request say DeploymentNotFound?
Validate the Imagen Rust MCP installation and its release build.
Write a Rust function that resizes a local image.
Choose a color palette for a landing page.

functional_evals.name: Configure Azure and generate
functional_evals.given: A connected Imagen MCP with Azure variables configured
functional_evals.when: The agent receives a request to generate an image
functional_evals.then: It checks configuration, uses the deployed model contract, polls check_job, and reports only completed artifacts or explicit errors.

functional_evals.name: Edit and continue safely
functional_evals.when: The agent performs two sequential edits
functional_evals.then: It waits for the first job, uses the returned session_id, rejects unsafe paths, and reports the final artifact.

functional_evals.name: Separate static and live evidence
functional_evals.given: A skill validation run without provider credentials
functional_evals.then: It reports structure and Rust checks as static evidence and labels live provider authentication as unexecuted.
